title: dev.qory.run.log
description: One chunk of a session's output, with that session's number as session, or of the run's host work outside a session, such as the lines of a fetch or a compose, with stream stderr and no session. A log line of a step of the host work has the step's number as step. On pipes: one line or 4096 bytes, whichever comes first, cut at a byte, so a multibyte character may straddle two chunks. On a pseudo-terminal: 4096 bytes or a quiet gap of 50 ms after the runtime's last write, whichever comes first, never cut inside a multibyte character, and a line break cuts nothing. The bytes are the writer's, the runtime's or the host work's, uninterpreted; output.log is their concatenation in sequence order.

stream.description: terminal on a pseudo-terminal; stdout or stderr on pipes.

session.description: The number of the session whose output the chunk is, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started. A chunk of the run's host work has none.

step.description: The number of the step whose log line the chunk is, from 1: the step of its dev.qory.run.step_started. The chunk lies between that event and the step's dev.qory.run.step_exited. A chunk outside every step has none. A chunk of a session has step only during the session's image or wall step: the text of a failure in that step.
